links.comparator_used: Default ChatGPT prompt without additional readability prompting
links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses (Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Additional prompting improved FRE to 55.6 ± 13.6 (p < 0.01). The default ChatGPT responses scored 42.3 ± 13.1.
links.quote: Additional prompting improved ChatGPT response readability (FRE 55.6 ± 13.6, p < 0.01).
